description: A custom addon mod for Wathe/Harpy Express for making other addon roles shop configurable

mods.name: WyspiaExpress
mods.description: A mod to overwrite noelle's roles, starry express, stupid express and kin's wathe custom role shop with a configurable one.

releases.notes:
# Changelog
- Killers shooting an executioner target with a revolver will now drop the revolver
- Added "don't want killer", "don't want neutral" and "auto join", that you can use while in the lobby or spectator. You can use them by opening the inventory
- Reverted filters on player selections on Judge, Morphling, Swapper and Bodymaker introduced in the last release.
- Made mood & task system more configurable server side
## Ui & hud
- Lich hud will now always display the amount of available revives even if the ability is on cooldown
- Being judged will now display how much of the glowing is remaining
- Moved the duration display hud to the top right
- Simplified the blackout duration timer, it will now first show the minimum, and after it has finished counted down it will show the remaining of the maximum
- You can now see the timer until a new task
- Added more spectator information when looking at a player: glowing duration, night vision duration, starstruck duration, current task and task timer
- A new custom round end announcement hud is made
## Misc
- Added commands for adding and removing modifiers
- Added commands to set task, and task timer
- Added a command to display the amount of times that has passed in the current round
- Added config support for Recaller
- Added a new config to set a threshold for timer increase
- Spectator messages now also show WHEN something happens
- Fixed guesser modifier not shown as enabled in the guidebook
- Fixed item cooldown resetting after a relogging
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CATastrophyCy/WyspiaExpress/compare/v0.8.0...v0.8.1

releases.notes:
# Changelog
- Added invisible armor set that is automatically equipped on all players when the game starts. This will prevent players telling each other apart with instinct or glowing effects 
- Fake revolver now recoils and has particle effect like a real gun
- Added new operator commands: "sv drag" to drag or remove a player from spectator voicechat, "revive" to revive and teleport a player. "setMood" to set the current mood of a player
- Licensed Villain can now see the time
## UI improvements
- **Added a new Guidebook accessible with the keybind F**. It has content synced with the server and is therefore much more informative! 
- The old guidebook accessed via inventory is deprecated and is no longer displayed.
- Updated Freezing and Depression bar's appearance
- Guesser, Swapper, Morphling, Bodymaker and Judge have their ui improved. It should no longer overlap, and should wrap properly when there are too many players.
- Morphling, Phantom, Starstruck and Robot will now have a hud displaying the remaining duration of their abilities
- Blackout duration is shown to killers and killer aligned neutrals in a hud; as well as to spectators
## Guesser improvements
- Ui improvement
- Guessing an invalid role, e.g misspelling, will no longer kill the guesser, instead it puts it at 5 second cooldown
- It is not possible to guess non-civilian role. Trying to guess a non civilian role is considered invalid
- Neutral and killers players will also appear in the guesser list
- Players that are Fragile Ghouls or Cultist are excluded from the guesser list
- It will no longer display roles that can't spawn in the current round. 
## Smoke bomb
Players that are under the smoke bomb effect:
- Can't use instinct and can't be seen with instinct
- Can't see crosshairs and can't be detected with crosshair
- Can't see other player's name and their name is also hidden
## Fixes
- Spectators will no longer lose information render when the light level is low (during blackout)
- Items such as Revolver will no longer despawn while the game is running
- Ritual Dagger will set the converted player's coin to the normal Cultist starting coin
- Ritual Dagger will now properly remove the converted player's guesser
- Crosshair will no longer detect invisible players
- Fixed Lich's revive HUD overlapping with Graverobber modifier
- Fixed poison showing incorrect duration for spectators
- Defense vial should now work with Robot

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CATastrophyCy/WyspiaExpress/compare/v0.7.9...v0.8.0
